## Promotion authority

**Only the human owner promotes.** Do not edit this file during an agent session *unless the
human explicitly requests a promotion pass in that session*. When they do, every belief the
agent writes is stamped `agent` in its status tag, so an audit can separate human-approved
beliefs from agent-approved ones and reverse the latter wholesale.

**Promotion cadence:** monthly, and after any research push that generates more than ~50
proposals. Each pass: rebuild the queue, promote against the criteria below, record the
decisions in `_system/memory/triage_ledger.json`, and append a row to the pass log at the
bottom of this file.

```
python _system/scripts/build_memory_triage.py                     # rebuild the undecided queue
python _system/scripts/build_memory_triage.py --ingest            # record [x]/[-] ticks
python _system/scripts/build_memory_triage.py --audit-promoted    # every `promoted` id still has a belief here
```

The ledger is **append-only**: a decided id is never overwritten, so re-ticking a
row to reverse it is refused with a warning, `--mark` exits non-zero, and nothing
changes. To re-decide, delete the id from `triage_ledger.json` and re-run with
`--previous-decision '{...}'` carrying the row you deleted — the ledger is not
tracked by git, so that field is the only record the reversal happened.

Ledger decisions are `promoted`, `rejected` and `dropped`. Use **`dropped`** when a
proposal is merged into another belief or set aside — `promoted` claims a belief
exists here, and `--audit-promoted` checks that claim, so it must not be used as a
generic "handled" marker. A promoted proposal that was reworded on the way in
carries a `memory_anchor` naming the belief that absorbed it; the anchor must
**double-quote a phrase that appears in this file verbatim**, so editing the belief
away breaks the audit. A bare path (`_system/memory/MEMORY.md`) is not an anchor —
every belief satisfies it — so `--audit-promoted` ignores it and falls back to
matching the proposal's text. Back-marking of pre-existing beliefs
(`--sync-promoted-from-memory`) is stamped `by: "backfill"`, never `agent`, so
reversing an agent's pass cannot unwind the human's earlier work.

**Promotion criteria** (all four, or it stays in the queue):

1. **Cited.** A source path that exists on disk — a filing, a wisdom PDF/extract, a framework
   doc, or the daily log that carries the reasoning. Verify the path before promoting; drop
   the bullet if you cannot.
2. **Durable.** A rule that will still be true next quarter. A dated price, a stance readout,
   a one-off run summary, or a per-ticker IRR is an observation, not a belief.
3. **Non-contradicting.** It does not conflict with an already-promoted belief. If it does,
   supersede the old one explicitly rather than letting both stand.
4. **Distinct.** Near-identical proposals are merged into one belief before promotion.
